verdict.rationale: The firm publishes a named, homegrown generative AI tool, ChatGD. The disclosure goes beyond marketing, giving architecture details: a secure enterprise instance of OpenAI models via Microsoft Azure, plus RAG over agreements supplied as context. It also maintains a dedicated generative AI resources page. Missing for 10: a published AI-use policy or client-facing disclosure of how AI is applied in client matters, an explicit link between ChatGD and client service deliverables, and independent corroboration.
